name: Ercoupe 415
manufacturer: ERCO (Engineering and Research Corporation) and successors
summary: Two-seat low-wing light aircraft designed to be spin-proof, with linked controls and a distinctive twin tail.

wings: Low wing with marked dihedral on the outer panels
fuselage: Short, rounded two-seat side-by-side cockpit with a canopy whose side windows slide down
Fixed tricycle gear with a tall nose leg
tail: Twin vertical fins and rudders at the ends of the horizontal tail

tellTales: Tiny low-wing two-seater with twin fins at the ends of the tailplane
Tall nose gear giving a nose-high stance
Bubble-like canopy with drop-down side windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The AA-1/AA-5 has a single fin; the Ercoupe has twin fins at the tailplane tips.
The DA20 has a T-tail and long slender wings; the Ercoupe has twin fins and a short wing.
